title: Webster
description:
S5 E5 — The Strike
The unconventional methods of Webster's teacher earn him an A from the students and a pink slip from an outraged PTA.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E6 — George's Brush With Life
After learning that his buddies from school have died, George quits his job and resolves to live life to the hilt.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E7 — The Importance of Being Worthy
Webster and Nicky's excitement over a fund-raiser they organized fizzles when the proceeds are stolen.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E8 — A Hell of a Weekend
A weekend at Wisconsin Dells with parents of Webster's best friend reveals more than Katherine and George want to see, they are nudists.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E9 — Simple Gifts
Katherine's rich Uncle Charles visits for Christmas. George is worried Webster is forgetting the important part of the season.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E12 — Christmas
When a loan shark comes after Ray's father for a bad debt, the family comes to his rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E13 — Double Double Date
The twins find themselves in double trouble when they switch identities and Tia winds up with two dates for the same party.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E14 — Reality Really Bites
For her film class, Tia "spices up" her family documentary by throwing all sorts of monkey wrenches into their lives.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E15 — The Volunteers
While volunteering at a local retirement home, Tamera becomes determined to help a grumpy old man find happiness again.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E16 — Valentine's Day
Valentine's Day finds Tamera trying to "steal back" her hot date, and Ray and Lisa wondering if the other person is in love with them.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E10 — Thanksgiving
With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E9 — Unappreciated Interest
Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E8 — Isn’t She Lovely?
Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E7 — A Den Is A Terrible Thing To Waste
A well-intentioned Moesha intervenes to try and stop her once-popular hangout, The Den, from being sold to a commercial developer, unaware that Andell stands to make a great deal of money on its sale.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E6 — Just Above My Head
Moesha finds her history teacher’s remarks racially offensive, but fears that confronting him might affect her grade and cost Niecy her scholarship.

S3 E8 — Tangled Web
In an effort to help Lester build his business, Mary takes some questionable steps to land him a big construction contract.

S3 E9 — The Most Happy Marriage
Mary and Lester are shocked when his cousin Ed's enviable 'picture-perfect' marriage suddenly falls apart.

S3 E10 — They're Playing Our Song
When Mary and Sandra go to court to settle a dispute over song royalties, Sandra's ammunition is veteran 'barrister' John Houseman, while Mary's ace in the hole is a 'Supreme' expert witness, singer Mary Wilson.

S3 E11 — Mistaken Identity
Mayhem and murder plague 227 when a mysterious man with a knife rents an apartment in Mary's building.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E1
An aspiring radio sports announcer, Malcolm, and his talkative, would-be tow truck driver roommate, Eddie, attend a get-rich-quick seminar in hopes of winning a much-needed TV.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E2 — Eddie By Moonlight
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E3 — On The Radio
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E4 — Partnership Of Fools
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E5 — Someday My TAFKAP Will Come
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E16 — Florence Meets Mr. Right
When George and Louise meet Florence's intended, they worry that he may be too good to be true -- and soon find out they are exactly right.
